_nota: Capa inglesa del archivo de prensa. Trae solo el aparato: el grupo, la linea de cada trabajo y la fecha. Los titulares NO se traducen, porque son del medio, y el nombre de la publicacion tampoco. Los trabajos siguen en español y por ahora solo tienen pagina española: desde la zona inglesa se enlazan marcados con lang=es.

medios.Proyecto Voces, Facultad de Comunicación: Proyecto Voces, School of Communication, University of Havana

trabajos.carlos-varela-el-riesgo-de-buscar: A 1994 conversation with the singer-songwriter Carlos Varela, just after the album Como los peces. It stayed unpublished for thirty years: the magazine that commissioned it never appeared.
trabajos.ramon-haiti-colores-al-desnudo: The painter on the palette knife he found while looking for something else, on faces that are neither male nor female, and on what he steals from Van Gogh, from Lam and from his own father.
trabajos.hipnosis-rebeldes-con-causa: An afternoon at the Patio de María with the leader of Hipnosis, a metal band with three women in it, in a scene where women are scarce.
trabajos.palabras-desde-una-flauta: During an interview with a flautist, a small miracle happens: it is her flute that answers the questions.
trabajos.la-trova-canta-a-dos-lentes: Two photographers, Alain Gutiérrez and Kaloian Santos, explain how you photograph a sound.
trabajos.el-loquito-locuras-de-pincel: El Loquito, the cartoon character created by René de la Nuez, returns in an anthology by Axel Li, and with him a whole line of Cuban graphic humour that said what could not be said.
trabajos.el-verde-de-las-canicas: A novel by Marvelys Marrero enters childhood without sweetening it. Do its paths lead to hopelessness?
trabajos.sonar-en-cubano: A review of a book of interviews with major Cuban musicians, first published in La Gaceta de Cuba. From Juan Formell to Orishas.
trabajos.palabras-sin-velo: Helen Hernández Hormilla interviews several Cuban women writers. Among other subjects, at length: what feminism is and is not.
trabajos.un-siglo-de-jazz-en-cuba: Leonardo Acosta travels a hundred years of jazz on the island. A vital book for understanding, and enjoying, the history of that music in Cuba.
trabajos.isla-en-negro: An anthology by Leopoldo Luis and Rafael Grillo tries to give the island back the crime story that the Special Period left without magazines.
trabajos.aqui-esta-zumbado: A review written as if it were a television programme, for a master of humour who deserved that joke.
trabajos.la-musica-en-cuba: Carpentier's La música en Cuba returns to the bookshops with the final chapter the author himself had removed.
trabajos.memorias-del-subdesarrollo: Forty years after the premiere of Tomás Gutiérrez Alea's film, its relevance is still being argued over.
trabajos.orquesta-aragon-los-75-del-futuro: Seventy-five years of the charanga that is the emblem of Cuban music. A journey from the astonishments of childhood, and a father's wisdom, to the discoveries of adulthood, with the Aragón playing throughout.
trabajos.una-trova-es-con-guitarra: The guitar of Cuban trova sings, from Sindo Garay to the filin, from the Nueva Trova to the sound of today.
trabajos.cesar-portillo-al-cesar-lo-que-es-del-fi: The ninetieth birthday of the man who made the filin a language of his own.
trabajos.juan-formell-trovar-con-los-pies: On the birthday of Los Van Van, a curious chapter of Juan Formell's work: is he a trovador with an orchestra?
trabajos.santiago-feliu-medio-vinilo: Fifty years of the singer-songwriter, told record by record.
trabajos.trova-electrica: A list made while washing up: the electric guitars that found their way into Cuban trova, from the GES to Habana Abierta.
trabajos.los-diez-discos-de-trova: Which records to put on for someone just arriving at Cuban trova, knowing the list is going to annoy somebody.
trabajos.trova-cubana-con-nombres-y-apellidos: Traditional trova, filin and Nueva Trova are not the same thing, and here is who is who, and why.
